title: Why cant i use the boat on water

posts.author: bw21
posts.body:
I'm running into an issue with my project in RPG Maker MV and could use some help or advice. Here's the situation:
I'm using the
A1 tileset
for my maps, but I've noticed that this tileset doesn't have the passability options that I need for the
boat
(or ships) to move on water.
Normally, you’d use the
B, C, D, or E
tilesets to define passability for water, but I can't switch to these tilesets because they contain essential tiles for my environment design. I’ve already customized my map with specific details that rely on the tiles from those other sets, so changing tilesets would mess up the design.
The
A1 tileset
seems to be missing the required boat passability markers, so my boat cannot move across water areas even though it’s supposed to.
Is there a way to either:
1:Enable or customize passability for
A1 tiles
so boats can move across water areas, or
2:Work around this issue without changing the tilesets I’ve already set up?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you misunderstood several facts on vehicle passability.
first, the boat and ship passability (which are NOT the same) are based on positioning of the tiles on the A1 sheet. you can get the definitions in the help file for the A1 tilesets.
Second, the boat can only travel tiles that are impassable to the player. Think of it this way: if a watertile is shallow enough for the player to walk, then it is too shallow for a boat or ship to float there.
So making all water passable like you did in your screenshot will block all boat travel.
So basically you have to change your tilesets back to the original settings at least for the A1 water to make use of the boat and ship at all.

B, C, D, or E
tilesets to define passability for water
Click to expand...
No, you wouldn't? Water is only a ground tile, and B+ are all by definition above the ground layer.
I'm a bit confused as to where you're getting these starting premises from.
The boat and ship are hard coded to have passability for the first A1 tile (boat) and the second one (ship).
If you open a new project with the default assets in MV, and look at the Overworld tileset, it's the tiles marked Sea and Deep Sea.
There are a number of vehicle-oriented plugins floating around that I'm sure can modify this, but that's the default functionality.
